centroid_position_difference_mm.meaning: Difference between the two transverse beam-centroid vectors.

centered_spatial_spread_difference_mm.meaning: Difference between the transverse spreads measured about each beam's own centroid.

mean_direction_difference_deg.meaning: Separation between the two mean forward beam directions.

centered_angular_spread_difference_deg.meaning: Difference between the angular spreads measured about each beam's own mean direction.

decision_policy.engineering_progression_pass: Not active until the required downstream energy acceptance thresholds are approved.
decision_policy.engineering_progression_fail: Any functional failure, missing required metric, basis mismatch, or violation of any approved threshold in continuous_engineering_acceptance blocks progression.
decision_policy.existing_convergence_results: Keep their original INCONCLUSIVE or sensitivity status; do not relabel them as converged.
decision_policy.future_review: Replace or revise this temporary policy when downstream oa-TOF acceptance, resolution and tolerance budgets are validated.

claim_limit: This draft records the approved family-wide spatial and angular direction and the verified shared evaluator, but cannot issue PASS until both required energy thresholds are approved. A future engineering-progression PASS will not establish numerical convergence, solver equivalence, absolute accuracy, solver superiority, optimization, Candidate or Formal qualification.
